Goal: Test at least 1 app today to protect your Credits from daily inactivity penalties.

The system automatically checks at 00:05 daily. If you didn't test any app on the previous day, Credits are deducted based on consecutive missed days:

• Day 1 missed: -1% Credits
• Day 2 missed: -2% Credits
• Day 3 missed: -5% Credits
• Day 4+ missed: -10% Credits
(Minimum deduction is 1 Credit if balance > 0)
